description: A collection of richly patterned rugs and cushions, arranged on a dark background. The rugs are intricately designed with floral motifs and geometric borders, featuring a blend of warm reds, blues, and golden threads. They have a textured, woven appearance and are adorned with fringes. Several square cushions are placed on top of the rugs, each covered in a distinct, elaborate fabric. The foremost cushion is particularly detailed, showcasing a dark, intricate pattern with hexagonal and geometric shapes. The overall presentation suggests a luxurious and traditional setting, possibly for relaxation or meditation.
